text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E at a gain felt satisfying, but I should sell based on my plan and risk limits—not just to lock in a win.","I should not hold a losing position merely to avoid admitting a mistake; reassess it objectively against the reasons I own it.","With prices that move randomly, I should not trade on recent swings or assume they predict what comes next; review my portfolio periodically and act only when my plan calls for it."]}
